dedupe_keys.name: mirca2000 global monthly irrigated and rainfed crop areas around the year 2000 version 1 1

description: MIRCA2000 gives global monthly growing areas of irrigated and rainfed crops around the year 2000 at 5 arc-minute resolution, with harvested area grids, maximum cropped area, condensed cropping calendars and growing periods for crops including wheat, rice, maize, soybean, sugar cane, cotton, coffee, cocoa and fodder grasses. The Zenodo record also describes related Global Crop Water Model outputs for 1998 to 2002. It was published by Portmann, Siebert and Döll (version 1.1) under the CC BY 4.0 licence, free to download as ASCII grids and country text files in 11 zips of about 1.1 GB, with documentation pages at Goethe University Frankfurt. Coverage is global. Caveats: it represents about 2000 only, and crop areas come from downscaled statistics. For simulation it gives when and where irrigated and rainfed crops grow each month, to time drought, heat and flood impacts on crops and irrigation water demand. Related catalogue records include MIRCA-BC-USMX for the United States and Mexico and the FAO AquaCrop model.
